metadata.title: The Zhukovskiy-Volterra gyroscope: geometry and reduction
metadata.abstract: We describe a symplectic reduction of the Zhukovskiy integrable case of motion of a rigid body about a fixed point with a gyroscope in $\mathbb R^n$ to an integrable magnetic flow on a sphere $S^{n-1}$. We also present Zhukovskiy's geometric interpretation of motion of the Euler top with a gyroscope, aka the Zhukovskiy--Volterra gyroscope, and perform a symplectic reduction of this system to an integrable magnetic flow on a $2$-dimensional sphere.
metadata.comment: 17 pages, 4 figures, the material in Section 2 appeared in the first version of arXiv:2601.03965

analysis.topic: 黎曼、亚黎曼、Finsler及特殊几何结构
analysis.workSummary: 将Rⁿ中带陀螺仪的刚体定点运动之Zhukovskiy可积情形辛约化为球面Sⁿ⁻¹上的可积磁流。作者同时介绍三维Zhukovskiy–Volterra陀螺仪的几何运动解释，并将其约化为二维球面上的可积磁流。
analysis.breakthrough: 建立特定可积刚体情形与球面可积磁流的约化联系。
analysis.limitations: 仅针对Zhukovskiy可积情形，摘要未给磁场、动量值及约化正则性条件。论文第2节曾见于较早稿件，新增范围须结合正文判断。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。

aiReview.note: 对该版本全部可提取页面做 AI 披露关键词检索，并核对命中段落；这不是对整篇数学证明的审读。全文常规检索和点写、连字、断行模型名补检未见生成式AI使用披露。第6页Astra候选来自A straightforward generalization，实际介绍高维刚体方程的推广，第15–17页为参考文献。 第14页致谢仅列研究经费。

analysis.priorityReason: 与辛几何及磁测地流相关，偏向可积系统。
